 Plus, breaking up the Alliance | Thursday, October 01, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View in browser 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 PRESENTED BY J.P. MORGAN 
 
 
   
 
 
 Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 By Dan Primack · Oct 01, 2026 
 
 
 📺 What to watch: We've posted a replay of Tuesday's "AI Across America" event in Boston, including my interview with Bain Capital Ventures partner Ajay Agarwal (begins at 32:30).

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Share today’s Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Top of the Morning 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Photo collage: Dan Primack/Axios. Photo: Steph Chambers/Getty Images

 
 
 
   
 
 Yesterday I spoke on the phone with Vinod Khosla, the legendary venture capitalist, entrepreneur and newly minted NFL owner.

 What follows is a transcript of our conversation, which preceded the Factory/Cognition dustup , lightly edited for clarity and brevity: 🏈 Seattle Seahawks Khosla last month paid a record $9.6 billion to buy the NFL club from Paul Allen's estate, after having spent several years as a minority owner of the San Francisco 49ers. 

 Had you been looking to buy an NFL team? 

 Khosla: No. This was the first one. And it wasn't really planned. I was with Joe Lacob, who's a friend and owns the [Golden State] Warriors, just a few months ago he said, 'You should really look at the Seahawks.'"

 "I told him that I hadn't even actually considered owning an NFL team, but we had the conversation and then began discussing it with my son — he and I have probably gone to half of all 49ers home games together over the past 28 years. My whole family loves football, but me and my son especially have a real passion for it." "It wasn't like this 10-year plan. It was a combination of passion, interest, and the convenience of having something that's an hour-and-20-minute flight. I wouldn't buy a team in Philadelphia or Washington, D.C. And the 49ers weren't going to be for sale any time soon." Do you worry about instinctively cheering a 49ers touchdown when they play Seattle, and being caught on camera? 

 "No, I'm not confused."

 Did the CTE issue give you any pause in buying a team? 

 "It's a risk that we looked at."

 You've talked about being a steward of the Seahawks and preserving what Paul Allen built. But I don't think you've formally committed to keeping the team in Seattle long-term. Will you make that commitment? 

 "I will never say never. Will this team be in Seattle 500 years from now? But I have no current plans to change anything about the team, including the coach, president, operation or Lumen Field. It all functions well."

 When that Lumen lease is up in 2032, the stadium will be around the age that other owners talk about renovations or new stadiums... 

 "Three months ago I wasn't even thinking about buying an NFL team. Now I ended up with a Super Bowl-winning team with one of the most amazing fan bases. But I know very little about running a team. I don't think I'll do anything but learn for a while."

 ✨ Artificial Intelligence Khosla Ventures was an early investor in OpenAI, and has dozens of other AI portfolio companies. 

 What did you make of what came out of this week's White House meeting with top AI execs? 

 "The most interesting risk in AI is not the OpenAI and Anthropic models. It's open-source models. They're way more dangerous because they can't be monitored. 

 "You go into Astra and try to do something like design an explosive or virus, they immediately know it. If you're doing it with Qwen, nobody knows it. Nobody is even monitoring. I don't know if this nuance has really come across." "Open-source should be allowed to run, but it should run on known platforms that can monitor what it's being used for, in the U.S. at least." Some people hear that and just say you're talking your book, or endorsing regulatory capture. 

 "Bullshit. They can say that. They can say everyone is greedy and don't care about what happens to the planet. But much of my life has been about doing things that are impactful for the climate, and I tell my LPs that I care about impact more than I care about profits — even though we've delivered a lot of profits to them."

 How do you square being a climate investor with being an AI investor, given the power needs? 

 "Yes, energy use is a problem. But it has spurred so much energy investment in things like fusion and super-hot geothermal. We're going to get a lot more clean energy sources because the demand finally is there for nonlinear growth. Otherwise it's all met by coal plants and nobody's shutting down coal plants, no matter what the environmentalists or I say."

 "Is this a problem between now and 2030? Yes. Is it a problem in 2035? No." 🕵🏻 Agents Khosla recently suggested that trust, not data, will be key to determining which agent-makers succeed and which fail. 

 Isn't trust one of the few advantages that incumbents have over startups? 

 "Do you trust Facebook? Would you give them your credit card information?

 "The question will be if the business model is aligned with the consumer or not. I said several years ago that a personal agent for consumers is one of the largest opportunities if they truly represent the consumer against the onslaught of marketers that are trying to get consumers to do things, buy things, read things, and believe things." Is that something you think the startup has to make explicit to the consumer? 

 "Yeah. We're not selling you to advertisers. That's not our market. We're serving you."

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 The BFD 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios

 
 
 
   
 
 Sycamore Partners is in talks to sell British pharmacy chain Boots to part of the billionaire Weston family for around $9 billion (including debt), per the WSJ.

 Why it's the BFD: Sycamore isn't wasting any time breaking up the Walgreens Boots Alliance, believing that it's worth less than the sum of its parts.

 Catch up quick: Sycamore acquired Boots as part of last year's $24 billion takeover of Walgreens, which previously had acquired Boots from KKR and Stefano Pessina for around $22 billion via a multi-year process.

 The bottom line: "Selling Boots at the price being discussed would be an early win for Sycamore, which is poised to make a sizable return on the sale. It would also allow the firm to focus on reviving Walgreen's U.S. operations." — Cara Lombardo & Ben Dummett, WSJ 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Venture Capital Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • Colossal Biosciences , the de-extinction company, is in talks to raise new funding led by insider TWG Global at between a $25b-$26b valuation, per Axios Pro . axios.link/4rGPgYV 

 • Armadin , a cybersecurity startup led by Mandiant founder Kevin Mandia, raised $255.5m in Series B funding at a valuation north of $2.5b. Accel and a16z led, joined by Bain Capital Ventures, Redpoint, and insiders 8VC, Ballistic Ventures, Google Ventures, In-Q-Tel, Kleiner Perkins, and Menlo Ventures. axios.link/4zbwLOQ 

 🚀 Varda Space, an El Segundo, Calif.-based orbital drug manufacturer, raised $251m in a Series D. Lux Capital and Natural Capital led, joined by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, 8090 Industries, Giant Step and Also Capital. axios.link/4iY8tmu 

 • GMI Cloud, a Mountain View, Calif.-based provider of GPU infrastructure and inference services, raised $223m in Series B funding. ARCHIV led, joined by Nvidia, DSC Investment, Trend Micro, KB Investment, Kyobo Life, and KT Corp. The company also secured a $445m credit facility led by CTBC. axios.link/4hGaTE1 

 • CScale , a Palo Alto, Calif.-based optical interconnect developer, raised $145m in Series C funding from Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, Premji Invest, Sutter Hill Ventures, Maverick Silicon, Nvidia, and Intel Capital. axios.link/4yoRLBL 

 🚑 AnaCardio, a Stockholm-based heart failure biotech, raised €62.5m in Series B funding led by Novo Holdings and the Ljungström family office. axios.link/3Vpln39 

 • Flow Engineering , an agentic platform for hardware development, raised $50m in Series B funding at a $750m valuation. Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management led, joined by Sequoia Capital, Human Capital, Evantic, SV Angel, Odyssey, and EQT. axios.link/4z2myUD 

 • Doxx , a Miami-based private agentic defined networking platform, raised $38m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . A16z led, joined by Animo Ventures and Focal.vc. axios.link/4dfShcD 

 • Relay , a Raleigh, N.C.-based smart radio startup, raised $36m. Paper Co. led, joined by Cerity Partners Ventures and G2 Ventures. axios.link/3TirdCV 

 • OuterSignal , an agentic customer intelligence platform for brands, raised $22m in Series A funding. Long Journey Ventures and Abstract Ventures led, joined by BAM Ventures, Top Shelf Ventures, SuperAngel Fund, and AME Cloud Ventures. axios.link/4hXczKB 

 • Restate , a German durable execution infrastructure startup, raised $20m. Singular led, joined by Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures. axios.link/4hw7fhn 

 • Ascerta , a Bellevue, Wash.-based AI spend analysis platform, raised $18m in Series A funding. Dell Technologies Capital led, joined by Hitachi Ventures, BGV, and Wipro Ventures. axios.link/4hBWAAe 

 🌎 ArkeaBio , a Boston-based developer of a vaccine to cut livestock methane emissions, raised $15m in Series A extension funding. AgriZeroNZ led, joined by Breakthrough Energy. axios.link/3Tw1Sp8 

 • Daptic , an NYC-based compliance software startup, raised $15m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . Canvas Ventures led, joined by IA Ventures and 8VC. axios.link/4ylxZXB 

 🚑 Skopos Bio , an Australian cancer biotech, raised A$12m in seed funding from Tenmile, Tin Alley Ventures, and Yosemite. axios.link/4dd0C0P 

 🚀 Hop Aero , a developer of autonomous hypersonic rockets for delivering cargo to military zones, raised $11m. Initialized Capital led, joined by YC, Lunar Ventures, System.One, and Outsized Ventures. axios.link/3VhYsXC 

 🚑 Astrocyte Pharmaceuticals, a Groton, Conn.-based cerebroprotective therapy biotech, raised $9.5m in Series B funding. DeepWork Capital led, joined by MintPharma Capital, Waterstar Capital, Dynagrow Capital, and Angel Star Ventures. axios.link/3VJYQy9 

 • Osavul , a hostile threat detection startup founded after Russia's invasion of Ukraine, raised €8.5m in Series A funding. 33N Ventures led, joined by Balnord, G+D Ventures, and 42CAP. axios.link/3ViTNEQ 

 🚀 Foundational , a U.K. developer of satellite positioning infrastructure, raised £8.2m from Inflection, Backed, Final Frontier, Adjacent, and Type One Ventures. axios.link/47vlq00 

 • Destro AI , a Brooklyn-based shared intelligence layer for warehouse robotics, raised $8m in seed funding. Base10 Partners and Bonfire Ventures led, joined by CoFound Partners. axios.link/3Ti2te1 

 • Deepslate , a German AI voice startup, raised €7.7m in seed funding. 42Cap led, joined by Alstin Capital and S1Ventures. axios.link/4hoCvyK 

 🚀 Charter Space, an El Segundo, Calif.-based space insurance startup, raised $5m in seed funding. Crystal Venture Partners led, joined by QED, Blank Ventures, Gaingels, and Hustle Fund. axios.link/4z1eT9a 

 🌎 Food Founders , a Swiss foodtech venture studio, raised €4m from family offices and angels. axios.link/4hywjTl 

 🚀 Blackswan Space , a Lithuanian maker of mission design simulator software, raised €2.5m led by Iron Wolf Capital . axios.link/4hy85c9 

 🚑 R1 Therapeutics, a Redwood City, Calif.-based kidney disease biopharma, raised $3m in Series A extension funding from Samsara BioCapital . axios.link/4y5s7B6 

 • Frank , a Portuguese insurtech, raised €2.9m led by Armilar and Start Ventures . axios.link/3VheuRz 

 
 
   
 
   
A MESSAGE FROM J.P. MORGAN

 
 J.P. Morgan helps startups expand into new markets 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 Jake Loosararian, co-founder and CEO of Gecko, chose J.P. Morgan early on as his startup's banking team. With the help of his dedicated J.P. Morgan team, Gecko successfully broke into new markets and navigated change with confidence.


 Learn how we support founders. 


 
   
 
   
 
 
 Private Equity Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • AGS American Glass Services , a portfolio company of The Sterling Group, acquired Mark Industries , an Elgin, Ill.-based commercial glazing contractor. axios.link/46USfmU 

 ⚡ Algebris Investments acquired Spanish renewable energy consultancy Vector Renewables from Nadara . axios.link/4iS3gwy 

 • Analysys Mason , backed by Bridgepoint, acquired Modulai , a Swedish AI consultancy. axios.link/4iYZhye 

 • Antin Infrastructure Partners acquired a majority stake in HP Helicopters , a Redlands, Calif.-based maker of specialty helicopters. axios.link/4y01fSF 

 ⚡ ArcLight Capital Partners acquired a 50% stake in IATP , a portfolio of 11 North American power infrastructure assets, from InfraBridge , a unit of DigitalBridge Group (NYSE: DBRG). Invenergy retains the other 50%. axios.link/4rGPq2t 

 • Blue Sage Capital invested in Clean Team , a Toledo, Ohio-based janitorial services firm. axios.link/4xSh0LC 

 • EMS , a Wynnchurch Capital portfolio company, acquired AMD Supply , a Deerfield Beach, Fla.-based distributor of fencing, hurricane shutters, and aluminum products. axios.link/4dJ7UcI 

 ⚡ Fusion Capital Partners acquired Pioneer Power Group , a Rockville, Md.-based electrical power systems study company. axios.link/3Vl7IKy 

 • KKR agreed to acquire a majority stake in Cisternina Logistics Private , an Indian bulk liquid and gas storage and logistics business. axios.link/4rKjU3I 

 • Manna Tree acquired a majority stake in creative agency Zambezi . axios.link/4hzM5xA 

 • Spectrotel , backed by Charlesbank Capital Partners and Grain Management , completed its acquisition of AireSpring , a Clearwater, Fla.-based provider of connectivity, managed services, and network infrastructure solutions. axios.link/4z7ZGmN 

 • TRG , a Gemspring Capital portfolio company, acquired Fentron , a Westerville, Ohio-based cybersecurity and advisory firm. axios.link/4xY9UFw 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Public Offerings 
 
 
   
 
 • BHAV Acquisition II , a SPAC led by reAlpha Tech founder Giri Devanur, filed for a $150m IPO. axios.link/3VnuaTg 

 • Southport Acquisition II , a SPAC led by Jeb Spencer (TVC Capital), raised $200m in its IPO. axios.link/4ctTi06 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Liquidity Events 
 
 
   
 
 • ElevenLabs , a London-based AI voice startup, completed a $300m employee tender offer at a $22b valuation. Wellington and T. Rowe Price led, joined by a16z, Lightspeed Venture Partners, EQT, and Goldman Sachs. axios.link/4xV5L54 

 • H.I.G. Capital sold Pinalli , an Italian beauty retailer, to Borletti Group . axios.link/4ddQDbB 

 🚑 IDEXX Laboratories (Nasdaq: IDXX) acquired CoVetAI , a Canadian provider of ambient listening and clinical workflow software for veterinary practices. Sellers include Chicago Pacific Founders . axios.link/3TB582l 

 • Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) agreed to buy Listen Labs , an SF-based customer research and human simulation platform, for a reported $2b. Listen Labs had raised over $100m from Ribbit Capital, Sequoia Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC. axios.link/4ysxKdu 

 • Transurban Group (ASX: TCL) agreed to buy a portfolio of Australian toll road assets from Canada Pension Plan Investment Board for A$4.5b. axios.link/3VqTyYg 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 More M&A 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Photo: Michael Loccisano/WireImage

 
 
 
   
 
 • Pophouse Entertainment acquired a 50% stake in Sia 's publishing and master music rights for $180m. axios.link/4hWmU9B 

 ⚡ Ampol (ASX: ALD) acquired Australian EV charging network Evie for A$225m. axios.link/4dKvYfk 

 • Deutsche Lufthansa and Air France-KLM submitted sweetened final bids for a stake in Portuguese airline TAP , per Bloomberg. axios.link/4hHU6Rc 

 🚑 Grindr (NYSE: GRND) agreed to acquire the parent company of Freddie , a telehealth provider of PrEP and HIV prevention care, for $250m in upfront cash and up to $70m in earnouts. Freddie backers include True North Fund, BDC Capital, and Panache Ventures. axios.link/4AIQoiD 

 • Lynas Rare Earths (ASX: LYC ) agreed to buy Meteoric Resources (ASX: MEI ) for A$968m in stock. axios.link/4ysgBk9 

 • Madison Square Garden Sports (NYSE: MSGS) plans to split the NY Knicks and NY Rangers into a pair of independent, publicly traded companies. axios.link/4z8zk4e 

 • Nebius (Nasdaq: NBIS) acquired Inferize , an Israeli inference optimization startup. axios.link/4APl95N 

 • Nuveen completed its £9.9b all-cash acquisition of Schroders . axios.link/4zcUePM 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Fundraising 
 
 
   
 
 • Ares Management raised $4.2b for a new PE secondaries strategies fund. axios.link/4hUsv0a 

 • BAG Ventures , an early-stage firm led by Google vets Bonita Stewart and Jackson Georges Jr., raised an $11.3m fund. axios.link/3U0wy1V 

 • DIG Ventures , focused on European enterprise and cloud infrastructure startups, raised $120m for its third fund. axios.link/4hofSdD 

 • Headline raised $400m for its eighth early-stage fund focused on European startups. axios.link/4rDQZhw 

 • Investcorp raised $1.22b for its second North American PE fund. investcorp.com 

 • Stride Consumer Partners of Boston raised $550m for its second fund. axios.link/4z9c7ih 

 🌎 TPG raised $10b for a second climate-focused PE fund, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4yeDczT 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 It's Personnel 
 
 
   
 
 • Otilia Ciotau joined VSS Capital Partners as managing director of AI and value creation. She previously was with The World Bank. axios.link/4z5Z4Oz 

 • Yusef Kassim joined Abry Partners as head of capital strategy and IR. He previously was with Advent International. axios.link/4y0euD9 

 • Yoshitaka Todoroki joined StepStone Group as vice chair of Japan. He previously was exec director of private markets for Japan's Government Pension Investment Fund. axios.link/4xRgxJt 

 🚑 Andrew Witty , former CEO of GSK and UnitedHealth Group, joined Hatteras Venture Partners as chairman. Hatteras also announced a first close on its second opportunities fund, targeting $100m, and named former National Cancer Institute director Ned Sharpless as head of creation strategies. axios.link/4z21f5G 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Final Numbers 
 
 
   
 
 Data: Dechert ; Chart: Axios Visuals Dechert reports that U.S. antitrust reviews are taking less time, but doesn't take a position on whether that's thanks to increased efficiency or decreased scrutiny.

 Deloitte also finds that the Trump administration prefers negotiated settlements over litigation, noting that neither the DOJ nor FTC has filed suit yet in 2026 to stop a transaction. 
 
   
 
   
A MESSAGE FROM J.P. MORGAN

 
 The bank that takes you from vision to venture backed 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 Unpredictability is part of a startup founder’s journey, as Grant Lee knows. With the stability and support J.P. Morgan provides, Grant and his team at Gamma have had the confidence to dream, build, and grow as they reimagine how people present and share their ideas.
